name: Holy Quran — Offline Reader
summary:
Holy Quran is a calm, distraction-free Quran reader built for Meta Quest.

Read the Arabic Uthmani text with the trustworthy Pickthall English translation or Elmalılı Hamdi Yazır's Turkish translation, side by side. Choose a dark or sepia reading theme, resize the Arabic text, bookmark verses, jump back to where you left off, and search the whole text — all without an internet connection.

Designed for a panel on Quest:
• Arabic + English or Turkish translation for every verse
• 114 surahs, 6,236 verses, fu
